properties.title: Towards Surgical World-Action Modeling: A Preliminary Joint Visual-Trajectory Forecasting for Surgical Motion Planning

membership.reason: Jointly forecasts future surgical visual latent token grids and 2D instrument trajectories over 15-step chunked autoregressive rollouts.
membership.counting_boundary: Verified L1 joint visual-trajectory forecasting world model (WT_PROCEDURE, BP_FORECAST).

properties.backbone: Frozen SurgMotion ViT-L + 3-layer Temporal Transformer + 3 Spatial Residual Blocks + frozen RGB decoder

properties.flow: 5 observed frames + 2D tool positions -> 3-step chunked autoregressive rollout (5 chunks = 15 steps) -> future visual latents & 2D tool trajectories

properties.purpose: Preliminary joint visual-state and 2D instrument-trajectory forecasting for surgical motion planning.

assertions.rationale: Frozen SurgMotion ViT-L visual encoder + MLP 2D trajectory embedder.
5-step causal visual token grid + 2D tool position history updated recursively every 3 steps.
15-step chunked autoregressive rollout (5 chunks of 3 steps) with scheduled sampling.
Frozen deterministic RGB decoder maps predicted latent grids to frames.

Evaluated 15-step future visual-state and 2D instrument-trajectory prediction across five 3-step segments (t+1:3 through t+13:15) on SurgWMBench (Table 1, pp. 7-8); chunked rollout consistently outperforms direct one-shot prediction across all horizons (first segment PSNR 23.105 vs 18.859 dB, SSIM 0.7971 vs 0.4713, LPIPS 0.1783 vs 0.6045, ADE 22.22 vs 45.77 px, FDE 31.64 vs 49.47 px).
Surgical motion planning and visual-trajectory anticipation.
15-step rollout PSNR (23.11 dB first segment) and 2D trajectory ADE (22.22 px) on SurgWMBench.
Rollout operates in ViT-L visual token latent space.

evidence_fragments.content: To bridge this gap, we present a preliminary joint visual-trajectory world-action model that simultaneously forecasts future visual states and instrument trajectories from historical surgical observations. Specifically, we encode historical video frames and tool trajectories into latent representations, which are processed by a temporal-spatial encoder and subsequently decoded through separate visual-state and trajectory prediction heads. Based on this preliminary architecture, a chunked autoregressive rollout is repeatedly applied to predict fifteen future steps. The chunked strategy consistently outperforms direct one-shot prediction across all evaluated horizons, improving first-segment PSNR from 18.86 to 23.11 dB and reducing ADE from 45.77 to 22.22 pixels.

Fig. 1. Overview of the proposed method. (a) Causal history encoding: five observed RGB frames are processed by the frozen SurgMotion ViT-L encoder to obtain causal token grids. (b) Closed-loop chunked future prediction: the predictor jointly forecasts future token grids and normalized 2-D tool positions in 3-step chunks; each predicted chunk updates the 5-step history for the next rollout, producing a total 15-step forecast.

Table 1 compares the direct one-shot prediction and chunked autoregressive rollout settings. The chunked rollout consistently outperforms direct prediction across all five future segments and all evaluated metrics. The largest performance difference is observed in the first prediction segment. Compared with direct one-shot prediction, chunked rollout improves PSNR from 18.859 to 23.105 dB and SSIM from 0.4713 to 0.7971. It also reduces LPIPS by 70.5%, from 0.6045 to 0.1783. For trajectory prediction, the ADE and FDE are reduced from 45.77 and 49.47 pixels to 22.22 and 31.64 pixels, respectively.

capability_assessments.rationale: Jointly forecasts future visual latent states and 2D tool trajectories over 15-step chunked rollouts without external action conditioning or closed-loop control (L1).

limitations: Progressive visual degradation and accumulated trajectory drift over longer horizons; no low-level robotic control.
notes: All 10 physical PDF pages extracted/read; page 4 visually inspected via rendered PNG.

legacy_cells.B: Towards Surgical World-Action Modeling: A Preliminary Joint Visual-Trajectory Forecasting for Surgical Motion Planning
legacy_cells.C: Huang, Weiliang, Liu, Huanrong, Zhang, Bob, Dou, Qi, Chen, Zhen, Gu, Yun, et al.
legacy_cells.O: Robot-Assisted Radical Prostatectomy (RARP), specifically suturing motions with needle insertion and extraction segments
legacy_cells.S: Given five observed surgical frames and their historical 2-D tool trajectory, predict the next 15 visual states and instrument positions.
legacy_cells.T: Suturing motion segments from robot-assisted radical prostatectomy videos; 1,637 valid segments with annotated surgical frames.
legacy_cells.AI: Endoscopic RGB video frames; historical two-dimensional instrument trajectory coordinates
legacy_cells.AJ: Frozen SurgMotion ViT-L visual encoder; multilayer perceptron for trajectory embedding; temporal-spatial encoder
legacy_cells.AM: Intermediate- and final-layer visual tokens are projected and fused additively with a spatially broadcast trajectory embedding.
legacy_cells.BL: Five observed frames; five-step history windows; three-frame prediction chunks rolled out to 15 future frames.
legacy_cells.BS: Future visual latent representations decoded to RGB frames, and future two-dimensional instrument trajectories.
legacy_cells.BT: Separate visual-state prediction and instrument-trajectory prediction heads.
legacy_cells.BV: Weighted combination of token MSE/cosine, RGB, Sobel-edge, temporal-difference, trajectory-position, velocity, and endpoint losses; reported weights 1, 0.05, 0.25, 0.10, 0.10, 5, 2, and 2.
legacy_cells.DQ: 1,637 valid segments; 32,740 annotated surgical frames; 20-point trajectory per segment.
legacy_cells.DY: Chunked rollout, t+1:3 vs t+13:15: PSNR 23.105 vs 17.982 dB; SSIM 0.7971 vs 0.6343; LPIPS 0.1783 vs 0.3047; ADE 22.22 vs 158.52 pixels; FDE 31.64 vs 172.12 pixels. Direct one-shot at those horizons: PSNR 18.859 vs 16.872 dB; SSIM 0.4713 vs 0.4264; LPIPS 0.6045 vs 0.6244; ADE 45.77 vs 195.27 pixels; FDE 49.47 vs 208.04 pixels.
legacy_cells.EL: Visual quality and trajectory accuracy progressively deteriorate with rollout horizon; long-horizon visual degradation and accumulated trajectory errors remain, including reduced fidelity and noticeable endpoint errors at t+12 and t+15.
legacy_cells.FL: Frozen SurgMotion ViT-L encodes observed RGB frames into visual-token grids; historical 2-D tool coordinates are embedded by an MLP and fused with projected visual features. A temporal-spatial encoder forms shared context; separate heads predict future visual latents and tool trajectories. Three-step chunks are fed back into a five-step history window to make a 15-step open-loop forecast; no planner is implemented or evaluated.
legacy_cells.FM: Introduces a preliminary joint visual-state and instrument-trajectory predictor, a three-step chunked autoregressive rollout with scheduled sampling, and a benchmark evaluation of joint visual-motion forecasting.
legacy_cells.FN: Chunked rollout outperformed direct one-shot prediction at every reported future segment. At t+1:3, chunked PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS were 23.105/0.7971/0.1783 and ADE/FDE were 22.22/31.64 pixels; at t+13:15 they were 17.982/0.6343/0.3047 and 158.52/172.12 pixels.
legacy_cells.FO: Both visual fidelity and trajectory accuracy deteriorate over longer rollouts, with accumulated errors; chunking reduces but does not eliminate this degradation.
legacy_cells.FP: Explore action conditioning, uncertainty modeling, and stronger visual-motion consistency.
legacy_cells.FQ: Scene-only generation and trajectory-only prediction have been studied separately, leaving consistency between instrument trajectories and future scene evolution unaddressed.
legacy_cells.FR: Demonstrates forecast of future visual latents and tool trajectories from historical observations, but not a transition conditioned on specified future actions, identified treatment/procedural effects, counterfactual comparison, planning or decision-quality results, prospective clinical evaluation, or clinical deployment.
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M3 Belief-state service; M5 Dynamics adapter; M6 Rollout service; M7 Outcome & causal layer
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Expose future-state forecasts through a time-aware dynamics interface and validate error versus horizon; treatment actions need separate evidence before intervention simulation.
